description: Frozen baseline and migration contract for the single Scene RtT and CPU indoor radial light field.

fixture.layout_rule: N x N modules; each module has a 6x6 interior and boundary lines every 7 tiles; rooms enumerate y-major then x-major
fixture.door_rule: north boundary lower-center at local x=3; doors enumerate with rooms
fixture.lamp_rule: supplied lamps use the first distinct floor cells in fixture enumeration order
fixture.preflight_rule: every canonical occupied cell must be in bounds and free of pre-existing building, door, stockpile, or Yard ownership; Floor, Wall, Door, lamp, SoulSpa, equipment, and Tank companion cells must also be terrain-walkable; Bridge is a fixture-seeded completion probe against the exact current 2x5 production completion geometry and does not claim that current player authoring validation accepts the generated river; reject the fixture instead of deleting or replacing world-generation content

indoor_mask_contract.cell_source: canonical completed floor cells in fixture enumeration order
indoor_mask_contract.checksum_algorithm: sha256 of canonical JSON object {"cells":[[x,y],...]} using the contract canonical encoder

actor_enumeration.rule: floor cells enumerate room y-major, room x-major, local y-major, local x-major; wrap only after every floor cell

fixture.building_showcase_rule: medium and large enumerate BuildingType order exactly once; canonical Floor, Wall, Door, SoulSpa, and OutdoorLamp entities are referenced, while the other seven roots are fixture-seeded through their current production completion route; every anchor and occupied cell is semantic fixture data
fixture.showcase_companion_entity_rule: showcase_companions counts logical placements; Tank BucketStorage creates one ECS entity per occupied grid

headless_audit: driver that only supports software rendering
